items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: he said, “Hal, Bird invented the melodies, I invented the rhythm.”

ctx.x: So you do A, you do A2, you’re expecting A3 but you just take a little bit of A2 and go off with it and next thing you know you’ve got a line. And it takes off and it has a life of its own. It’s almost magical. I had the good fortune to spend a week with Dizzy Gillespie when he was a guest for Phil’s band. We toured a week with him. I was never the same after that. Dizzy totally turned me around to realize the rhythmic basis, he said, “Hal, Bird invented the melodies, I invented the rhythm.” And his legacy, Mike…
I think a shuffle is the most entrancing beat that — it just like.
